about: Mutants of the limiter's generated clients, held to the limits.Limiter laws under the named contexts of loopback/tests.ergo (HUB-CLIENT-UNFED). Killers are the examples suite (examples:limiter): each rule names the law that refutes the mutant.

mutants.name: hcu-rpc-drops-retry-after
mutants.rule: The RPC Client is held to the limits.Limiter laws under overMemory (loopback/tests.ergo): a Client that drops Limited's RetryAfterMs on its way back is refuted by RetryAfterIsExact.

mutants.name: hcu-hub-drops-retry-after
mutants.from:
case Limited as failure:
			return failure.E
mutants.to:
case Limited as failure:
			return limits.Limited{RetryAfterMs: failure.E.RetryAfterMs * 0}
mutants.rule: The hub Client is held to the limits.Limiter laws under overHub (loopback/tests.ergo): a Client that drops Limited's RetryAfterMs in transit is refuted by RetryAfterIsExact.
